evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not run commands, inspect files, call agents, write files, or mutate git. Run /prep-ticket without a ticket ID on feature branch feature/catalog-cleanup, which has no ticket pattern matching [A-Za-z]{2,5}-\d+. The configured Linear provider availability probe `command -v linear` is unavailable and returns the normalized exact failure `linear: command not found`; no ticket lookup can be attempted. The repository has committed branch changes relative to its merge-base, staged changes, and unstaged changes. Describe the action trace and the readiness report. Expect repository-only discovery to inspect all three change sets, preserve the provider probe's exact command, status, and stderr, and continue from repository, branch, and diff evidence. The report must explicitly mark ticket context unavailable, must not invent requirements or acceptance criteria, and must contain exactly one lazy evidence-backed Suggested Approach. Do not ask for a ticket ID or repeat a lookup question.
evals.expected_output: Enters repository-only mode after finding no ticket ID in the arguments or branch, runs `command -v linear` as a non-ticket provider availability probe without attempting a ticket lookup, and records its exact command, exit status, and stderr including normalized `linear: command not found`. It inspects committed changes from the merge-base through HEAD plus staged and unstaged changes, then continues the repository/diff scan. The report distinguishes unavailable ticket facts from repository evidence using separate Provider probe and Ticket lookup fields, does not invent requirements or acceptance criteria, and gives one laziest evidence-backed Suggested Approach without asking for a ticket ID or repeating lookup.
expectations: Continues codebase/repository discovery in repository-only mode despite the unavailable provider CLI.
